sources.title: Tesla's AI5 Chip Prototype Ushers in a New Era of Custom AI Silicon ...
sources.snippet: At the heart of the AI5 sits a new custom CPU core—codenamed "Zephyr"—which handles traditional control-flow, power management, and scheduling tasks. Zephyr is a 64-bit ARMv9-derived design, extended with Tesla-specific ISA extensions to accelerate mixed-precision tensor operations.
